title: CCP-15: RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF constant in all constant files (R-02a-133 slice of b7z9.29)
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.29 residue: R-02a-133 (MUST) metrics over rolling RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 superframes — the constant is absent from all constant files. Add: rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs (RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF: u32 = 32), C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/rf_health.h (LICHEN_RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF 32u), python/src/lichen/ccp.py (RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF = 32) — each with the spec citation (spec/02a 2a.10.4, docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-133). Machinery (rolling window consumption) remains with the parent.
